settings.title: Child-safe & super soft
settings.text: Virgin-grade polyfill, embroidered faces and no small plastic parts.

settings.title: Discreet secret delivery
settings.text: Go fully anonymous. We never print prices or your name on the package.

settings.title: Christmas scheduling
settings.text: Pick a delivery date between Dec 20 and Dec 25 right in your cart.

settings.title: Describe your Secret Santa
settings.text: Five playful questions about their personality, habits and your budget.

settings.title: Meet their plush twin
settings.text: We decode their vibe and match them with soft toys that fit it.

settings.title: Add a secret message
settings.text: Write a gift note, stay anonymous, and choose a Christmas delivery date.

settings.question: Will the recipient know who sent the gift?
settings.answer: Only if you want them to. Tick Deliver anonymously in the cart and we'll leave your name and the price off the package.

settings.question: Can I choose the delivery date?
settings.answer: Yes. Pick a preferred date between Dec 20 and Dec 25 in the cart before checkout.

settings.question: Can I add a personal message?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Every product page has a Secret Santa box for the recipient's name and a gift message. We tuck it inside the parcel.

settings.question: Do you save my quiz answers?
settings.answer: No. The matchmaker runs in your browser and your answers are never sent to us.
